equations.name: rotation from closest approach
equations.purpose: Places the same configured false Sun along its fixed-latitude rotation at requested angular offsets from closest San Jose approach.
equations.source: algorithmic diagnostic math from app configuration

equations.name: observer source direction
equations.purpose: Computes each local source direction seen from the San Jose observer.
equations.source: algorithmic diagnostic math from app configuration

equations.name: configured local Sun incident scale
equations.purpose: Treats the finite source-to-sample distance as the configured local Sun distance and applies the app-config inverse-square local radiance model.
equations.source: app configuration DEFAULT_ATMOSPHERE.rendering.falseSunRadiance plus algorithmic source object contract

equations.name: round-equivalent artificial-cap view path endpoint
equations.purpose: Lets the skydome renderer terminate flat/local observer view rays at an artificial cap with the same observer-level footprint radius as the round atmosphere.
equations.source: Algorithm32 POC transport contract plus round-equivalent artificial-cap geometry decision

equations.name: configured flat source transmittance path
equations.purpose: Keeps source-path optical depth tied to the configured flat atmosphere geometry instead of the skydome renderer's artificial view-ray limit.
equations.source: Algorithm32 POC transport contract plus renderer-scoped sky-view limit decision

equations.name: Algorithm32 flat/local first-order local source scattering
equations.expression: L += T_view * T_source * incidentScale(lambda) * density * scatteringCoefficient(lambda) * phase(viewDirection, sourceDirection) * ds
equations.purpose: Integrates local finite-source incident light through the first-order Algorithm32 scattering loop using flat altitude density, renderer-provided view distance, and configured flat source-path transmittance.

equations.name: fisheye diagnostic projection
equations.expression: rho = (pi/2 - asin(direction.z)) / (pi/2); x = cx + cos(azimuth) * rho * R; y = cy - sin(azimuth) * rho * R
equations.purpose: Maps each local source direction into JSON marker diagnostics for the generated observer sky view; markers are not painted into the PNG.

constants.coordinateFrame: flat transport frame, meters, z up; app flat scene is converted from kilometers and y up

skyViewRayLengthLimit.scope: observer angular sky renderer only; not a flat atmosphere or scene-renderer distance limit

flatGeometry.viewDistancePolicy: same fisheye skydome loop as round Algorithm32; only the observer sky renderer terminates flat view rays at a round-equivalent artificial cap while atmosphere density and source paths use flat z-up geometry

brightnessCalibrationTarget.targetIncidentScaleUnits: multiple of Algorithm32 distant-directional-sun top-of-atmosphere solar irradiance
